newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's Jan-April cement output rises 11.7 percent.
newsitem.headline: Peru's Jan-April cement output rises 11.7 percent.

text.p: Peru's cement output was 1.341 million tonnes in the first four months of the year, up 11.7 percent from the same period last year, the private Association of Cement Producers (ASOCEM) said Tuesday.
Output in April was 344,000 tonnes, ASOCEM said in its monthly report, without giving a comparative figure.
The biggest cement producer in the first four months of the year was Cementos Lima with 621,000 tonnes, followed by Cementos Norte Pacasmayo with 266,000 tonnes.
Peru produced 3.848 million tonnes of cement in 1996.
